tema: The parts of a plant and their functions
objetivo: For students to identify the parts of a plant (root, stem, leaves, flower, and fruit) and the function of each, and understand that they all work together to keep it alive.
hatsumon: Why does a plant wilt if you cut off its root?

turnos.utterance_formal: Today we're going to take apart a plant in our minds to see what parts it's made of.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Today we're going to take apart a plant in our minds to see what parts it's made of.

turnos.utterance_formal: Take out your notebooks; at the end you're going to work on a complete plant.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Take out your notebooks; at the end you're gonna work on a whole plant.

turnos.utterance_formal: Think about something: why does a plant wilt if you cut off its root?
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Okay, think about it: why does a plant wilt if you cut off its root?

turnos.utterance_formal: Hold on to your answer; we'll come back and answer it properly at the end.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Hold on to your answer; we'll come back and answer it properly at the end.

turnos.utterance_formal: A plant is a living thing, and like every living thing, it has several parts.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: A plant is a living thing, and like every living thing, it has several parts.

operations.text: A plant is a living thing with several **parts**

turnos.utterance_formal: Each part takes care of a different job for the plant.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Each part's got a different job for the plant.

set.text: A plant is a living thing with several **parts**, and each part has a different job.

turnos.utterance_formal: Job here means function: what each part is for.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Job here means function — what each part's for.

set.text: A plant is a living thing with several **parts**, and each part has a different job. Job here means **function**: what each part is for.

turnos.utterance_formal: There are five main parts: the root, the stem, the leaves, the flower, and the fruit.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: There are five main parts: the root, the stem, the leaves, the flower, and the fruit.

turnos.utterance_formal: Let's go through them one by one and see what each part does.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Let's go through them one by one and see what each part does.

turnos.utterance_formal: Let's start from the bottom: the root, which is almost always buried underground.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Let's start from the bottom: the root, which is almost always buried underground.

turnos.utterance_formal: Its main job is to soak up water and nutrients from the soil.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Its main job is to soak up water and nutrients from the soil.

operations.text: The root absorbs water and nutrients from the soil

turnos.utterance_formal: That's why the root grows downward, searching for water.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: That's why the root grows down, looking for water.

set.text: The root absorbs water and nutrients from the soil, so it grows downward searching for water.

turnos.utterance_formal: Moving up a bit is the stem, which is like the trunk.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Moving up a bit is the stem, which is like the trunk.

operations.text: The stem **holds up** the plant and lifts it

turnos.utterance_formal: Also, inside the stem, water travels up from the root to the leaves.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Also, inside the stem, water travels up from the root to the lea ves.

set.text: The stem **holds up** the plant and lifts it, and inside it water travels up from the root to the leaves.

turnos.utterance_formal: The stem is like the pipe and the pole of the plant at the same time.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: The stem is like the pipe and the pole of the plant at the same time.

set.text: The stem **holds up** the plant and lifts it, and inside it water travels up from the root to the leaves. The stem works like a pipe and a pole at once.

turnos.utterance_formal: So far we have two parts: the root and the stem.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: So far we've got two parts: the root and the stem.

turnos.utterance_formal: Up top are the leaves — they're green and flat.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Up top are the leaves — they're green and flat.

turnos.utterance_formal: Their job is the most important one: they make food using sunlight.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Their job is the most important one: they make food using sunlight.

operations.text: Leaves make food using **sunlight**, the plant's most important job

turnos.utterance_formal: Let's look at the whole plant so we can point things out on it.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Let's look at the whole plant so we can point stuff out on it.

turnos.utterance_formal: Notice that almost every plant has these parts? Even a little tree.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Notice that almost every plant has these parts? Even a little tree.

turnos.utterance_formal: Notice the path of the water: it goes in through the root, up through the stem, and reaches the leaves.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Notice the path of the water: it goes in through the root, up through the stem, and reaches the lea ves.

turnos.utterance_formal: By the way, that trip the water makes up through the plant, from the root to the leaves, is called transport.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: By the way, that trip the water makes up through the plant, from the root to the leaves, is called transport, ok?

turnos.utterance_formal: That's why, along with the food they make, the leaves look so green.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: That's why, along with the food they make, the leaves look so green.

turnos.utterance_formal: We're at three parts now; pay special attention to the job of the leaves.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: We're at three parts now; pay special attention to the job of the leaves.

turnos.utterance_formal: Now the prettiest part: the flower, the one that catches your eye.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Now the prettiest part: the flower, the one that catches your eye.

operations.text: The flower is the showy, colorful part

turnos.utterance_formal: And it's not just to look pretty: the fruit is born from the flower.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: And it's not just to look pretty: the fruit is born from the flower.

set.text: The flower is the showy, colorful part, and the **fruit** is born from it.

turnos.utterance_formal: I'll leave you an example flower next to its part.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: I'll leave you a little example flower next to its part.

turnos.utterance_formal: That's why many flowers smell nice: to attract bees.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: That's why many flowers smell nice: to attract bees.

operations.text: Many flowers smell nice to attract bees

turnos.utterance_formal: And the last part is the fruit, which holds the seeds inside.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: And the last part is the fruit, which holds the seeds inside.

set.text: Many flowers smell nice to attract bees. The last part is the **fruit**, which holds the seeds inside.

turnos.utterance_formal: And from each seed a new plant can be born: that's how it starts all over again.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: And from each se ed a new plant can be born: that's how it starts all over again.

operations.text: A new plant can be born from each **seed**

turnos.utterance_formal: Have you ever eaten seeds without noticing? In watermelon, for example.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Have you ever eaten seeds without noticing? In watermelon, for example.

turnos.utterance_formal: Notice the two parts that give new life: the flower and the fruit.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Notice the two parts that give new life: the flower and the fruit.

turnos.utterance_formal: Now, here's the important part: no part works alone, they all help each other.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Now, here's the important part: no part works alone, they all help each other.

operations.text: If one part is **missing**, the plant gets sick

turnos.utterance_formal: Let's go back to the beginning: if you cut the root, the plant can no longer take in water and it wilts.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Let's go back to the beginning: if you cut the root, the plant can no longer take in water and it wilts.

set.text: If one part is **missing**, the plant gets sick, so without its root the plant cannot take in water and it **wilts**.

turnos.utterance_formal: A part that fails affects the whole plant, just like in our bodies.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: A part that fails affects the whole plant, just like in our bodies.

set.text: If one part is **missing**, the plant gets sick, so without its root the plant cannot take in water and it **wilts**. A part that fails affects the whole plant, just like in our bodies.

turnos.utterance_formal: That's why we need to take care of plants: don't pull them up or step on them.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: That's why we need to take care of plants: don't pull them up or step on them.

operations.text: Take care of plants: don't pull them up or step on them.

turnos.utterance_formal: Go back to the question from the beginning: now we can answer it.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Go back to the question from the beginning: now we can answer it.

turnos.utterance_formal: Rest your hand for a moment and then we'll wrap up with the important part.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Give your hand a little rest and then we'll wrap up with the important part.

turnos.utterance_formal: Hold on to the big idea for today, the one that sums everything up.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Hold on to the big idea for today, the one that sums it all up.

set.text: Take care of plants: don't pull them up or step on them. A plant has **roots**, a stem, leaves, a flower and **fruit**.

turnos.utterance_formal: And with that: each part has its function, and together they keep it alive.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: And with that: each part has its func tion, and together they keep it alive.

set.text: Take care of plants: don't pull them up or step on them. A plant has **roots**, a stem, leaves, a flower and **fruit**. Each part has its **function** and together they keep the plant alive.

turnos.utterance_formal: And today's big word, the one you shouldn't forget, is function.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: And today's big word, the one you shouldn't forget, is function.

set.text: Take care of plants: don't pull them up or step on them. A plant has **roots**, a stem, leaves, a flower and **fruit**. Each part has its **function** and together they keep the plant alive. The key word is **function**.

turnos.utterance_formal: Remember the main idea: all the parts together keep the plant alive.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Remember the main idea: all the parts together keep the plant alive.

turnos.utterance_formal: Very good, I can see it's clear. Excellent work.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Very good, I can see it's super clear. Excellent work.

turnos.utterance_formal: Take one last look at the five parts we studied today.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Take one last look at the five parts we studied today.

turnos.utterance_formal: Do you all have them written down? Perfect.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: Do you all have them written down? Alright, perfect.

turnos.utterance_formal: For homework, draw a plant and label its five parts.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: For homework, draw a plant and label its five parts.

operations.text: Draw a plant and label its 5 parts.

turnos.utterance_formal: And next to each part, write down what its function is.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: And next to each part, write down what its func tion is.

set.text: Draw a plant and label its 5 parts. Next to each part, write what its function is.

turnos.utterance_formal: That's all for today. Pack up your things and see you tomorrow.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: That's all for today. Pack up your things and see you tomorrow.

turnos.utterance_formal: And water your plant at home, if you have one; it'll come in handy tomorrow.
turnos.utterance_coloquial: And water your little plant at home, if you have one; it'll come in handy tomorrow.
